88fdedb000c981cbfac6.headline: U-Ramaphosa uzokhuluma emngcwabeni kaMlambo-Ngcuka
88fdedb000c981cbfac6.dek: Sekela-mengameli wesifazane wokuqala eNingizimu Afrika uzothola izwele zohlobo 2, kuhlanganisa nemikhosi yempi, emzileni eEastern Cape.
88fdedb000c981cbfac6.why: Umngcwabeni kahulumeni umbeka phakathi kwalabo abahlonishwa ngamahhovisi aphakeme omphakathi, kunemikhosi yezempi ebekelwe le nkonzo.
paragraphs: UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa uzokhuluma emngcwabeni kahulumeni kaPhumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, obeyisekela-mengameli wesifazane wokuqala eNingizimu Afrika, eEastern Cape ngoMgqibelo, mhla ziyi-28 kuNovemba. Inkonzo ihlelelwe eXesi Village eMiddledrift.

IZiko likaMengameli lithe uMlambo-Ngcuka uzothola Umngcwabeni Kahulumeni Wohlobo 2, ohlanganisa inhlonipho yezempi eyenziwa yiSouth African National Defence Force. Lolu hlobo lubekelwe amasekela-mengameli asasebenza nawake asebenza nababambe izikhundla zobungameli. UMlambo-Ngcuka ukhothame mhla zingama-20 kuNovemba 2026, eneminyaka engama-71, emva kokugula kakhulu ngenxa yenqubo yezokwelapha yakamuva.
Okhulumela uMongameli uVincent Magwenya uthe ubengumqashi kwezombusazwe yenkululeko wabe eseba ngumqondisi omkhulu we-UN Women kusukela ngo-2013 kuya ku-2021.

c922747f7c0acdfea1b2.headline: Izikhukhula zikhukhula imijondolo zavimba nemigwaqo
c922747f7c0acdfea1b2.dek: Umonakalo wesiphepho ufake amanzi emijondolweni, waphazamisa izinsiza zomphakathi waphinde wonakalisa ibhuloho ku-R542 eduze kwaseBoomplaas.
c922747f7c0acdfea1b2.why: Abahlali baseEkurhuleni naseGoli babhekene namakhaya akhukhulekile nokuvaleka kwemigwaqo, kanti ithrafikhi eduze kwaseBoomplaas ipambukisiwe ngenkathi kuhlolwa ibhuloho.
paragraphs: Imvula eningi ngoLwesibili nangoLwesithathu ifake amanzi emakhaya, yakhukhula imijondolo yonakalisa nemigwaqo eGauteng naseMpumalanga. EBethal, eMpumalanga, abafana ababili abasha baminze ngezigameko ezihlukene. Amathimba ezimo eziphuthumayo ahlenge abashayeli bezimoto njengoba amanzi ezikhukhula emboze imigwaqo namabhuloho.

UMasipala Wase-Ekurhuleni uqophe izigameko ezingama-20 ezihlobene nesiphepho, kubandakanya ukuhlengwa kwabantu abayi-15 emanzini namacala amahlanu ezihlahla eziwele phansi. Imijondolo eminingi endaweni yaseGugulethu kubikwa ukuthi ikhukhulekile, kanti amakhaya aseSkomplaas, eSprings, angene amanzi. Okhulumela izicishamlilo zaseGoli uRobert Mulaudzi uthe amapayipi amanzi emvula avalekile anegalelo ezikhukhuleni. I-Johannesburg Roads Agency ivaliwe uMgwaqo uNasrec emva kokuba ingqalasizinda iwile.

E-Mpumalanga, izikhukhula zonakalise amahhovisi nemishini esiteshini samaphoyisa saseEvander zaphazamisa ugesi nezinsiza zobuchwepheshe esiteshini saseKwaMhlanga. Ibhuloho ku-R542 eduze kwaseBoomplaas lonakele, futhi iziphathimandla zapambukisa ithrafikhi ngenkathi zisahlola. Imigwaqo yaseMoloto ayasakwazi ukuhanjwa, futhi nesibhedlela sendaweni sithintekile.

86d1f36882225e89d5c2.headline: Inkantolo eNkulu yaseWestern Cape ichitha umbiko wePhala Phala
86d1f36882225e89d5c2.dek: Isinqumo siyayeka umbiko owayevule indlela yezinqubo zokuhoxiswa kukaMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa ephalamende.
86d1f36882225e89d5c2.why: URamaphosa nePhalamende manje kufanele baphendule esinqumweni sencantolo esichitha umbiko owawusekelwe ezinqubweni zokuhoxiswa.
paragraphs: Inkantolo eNkulu yaseWestern Cape eNingizimu Afrika ngoLwesibili, mhla zingama-25 kuNovemba 2026, ichithe ngokuphelele umbiko wephaneli ezimele yesigaba 89 ngoMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa nepulazi lasePhala Phala. Isinqumo, esikhishwe eKapa, silandele inselelo yezomthetho kaRamaphosa emiphumeleni yepaneli.

Jaji Omkhulu Nolwazi Penelope Mabindla-Boqwana uthe umbiko wawunecala elikhulu. Iphaneli yayiphenyile ukwebiwa kwamaRandi angaba yizigidi ezingama-$580 000 (cishe amaRandi ayizigidi eziyi-9.6) epulazini lezilwane zikaRamaphosa eLimpopo ngoFebhuwari 9, 2020. Umbiko wawuvule indlela yezinqubo zokuhoxiswa kukaMongameli ephalamende.
Enye i-akhawunti yesinqumo yathi ichitha ikomiti lokuhoxiswa kwePhalamende, kanti izikhalo zokuphikisa zagcina ingxabano yezombusazwe ipila.

cf02d76034be151cd437.headline: SA yehlisa isibikezelo sokuthunyelwa kwamawolintshi
cf02d76034be151cd437.dek: I-Citrus Growers Association ithi izikhukhula kanye nemikhawulo yaseziteshini kuqhube isilinganiso sika-2026 saba ngaphansi ngo-1.5% kunoka-2025 nango-4% ngaphansi kwesibikezelo sika-April.
cf02d76034be151cd437.why: Abalimi bamawolintshi namagilebhasi abhekene nemithamo ephansi yezibikezelo zokuthunyelwa kwamanye amazwe, kuyilapho iziteshini zasekhaya zihlala ziwumkhawulo ngaphambi kwesizini yokuthumela yangowezi-2027.
paragraphs: I-Citrus Growers Association yaseNingizimu Afrika ibikezele amabhokisi angu-201 million ama-15kg esizinini samawolintshi sika-2026, ngaphansi ngo-1.5% kunoka-2025 nango-4% ngaphansi kwesilinganiso sayo sika-April sezigidi ezingama-209.4. Izikhukhula phakathi kukaMay naJune kwezinye izingxenye zeEastern naWestern Cape, Limpopo naseMpumalanga, kanye nemikhawulo yaseziteshini zasekhaya, kuholele ekubuyekezweni.

Isilinganiso sokuqala seSouth African Table Grape Industry sika-2026-27 singamabhokisi ayizigidi ezingama-78.4 ahloliwe okuthunyelwa kwamanye amazwe, yehle ngo-4% kusuka esizinini esidlule kodwa yaphezulu ngo-1% ngaphezu kwesilinganiso seminyaka emihlanu. Ukuthunyelwa kwamawolintshi namagilebhasi kwenza ama-24% okuthunyelwa kwezolimo kwaseNingizimu Afrika kwezigidigidi ze-US$15.1 ngo-2025; amaawolintshi abiza amaRandi ayizigidi eziyizi-US$2.5 billion kanti amagilebhasi namagilebhasi omisiwe abiza ama-US$1.1 billion.

Amazinga aphezulu amadamu emva kwemvula yasehlobo ka-2025-26 asekela ukukhiqizwa okuniswayo, kodwa ukuhlaziya kuyaxwayisa ngokuthi isomiso se-El Niño singasinda ezitjalweni zasemasisweni nakwezinye izithelo kanye nemifino ngo-2027. Kuphinde kuveze nokushisa kwesimo sezulu kwamanje nokungenzeka kube yingozi yemvula.
